name: Floh- und Trödelmarkt im Bürgerpark

rhythm.de: Einmal im Monat am zweiten Samstag, März bis November
rhythm.en: Once a month on the second Saturday, March to November

facts: run by the city of Saarbrücken
on the Hafeninsel by the Saar, near the main station
second-hand only — new goods may not be sold
about 195 pitches of one to ten metres
stall 7 EUR per running metre, booked four weeks ahead
sellers with a pitch of six metres or more may park behind it
notes: The city lists nine dates for 2026, 14 March to 14 November, always the second Saturday; 10 October and 14 November are the two inside the window and 2027 is not published yet. Visitor entry is not stated — it is an open park, so probably free, but left null. The city's booking page (saarbruecken.de/.../flohmarkt_buchen) carries the date list and the rules; the event page used as source_page carries the hours, address and stall price. Not to be confused with the Ludwigsflohmarkt on Ludwigsplatz, a different market that runs March to September. Coordinates from Nominatim for the Bürgerpark Hafeninsel.

description.de: Am zweiten Samstag im Monat von März bis November auf der Hafeninsel an der Saar, nahe dem Hauptbahnhof. Rund 195 Standplätze, nur Gebrauchtes — gewerbliche Händler sind nicht zugelassen. Der Markt gehört der Stadt Saarbrücken; Stände werden vier Wochen im Voraus gebucht.
description.en: The second Saturday of the month from March to November on the Hafeninsel by the Saar, near the main station. Around 195 pitches, second-hand only — commercial dealers are not admitted. The market belongs to the city of Saarbrücken; stalls are booked four weeks ahead.
